$comment: field-mapping-server-write-path-r1 task 051 (FR-24). The ONE list of what the native UI does for each mapping-target table (the 22 sprk_ tables of RecordTableRules.All that the task 050 decision names, plus sprk_procedureversion, registered by ebilling-r1 DEF-061 after that decision). Read by Merge-NativeCreateRibbon.ps1 (authors the ribbon) and scripts/Test-NativeCreateSurfaces.ps1 (checks an environment). A guard (tests/scripts/Test-NativeCreateSurfaces.Tests.ps1) keeps the table list equal to the sprk_ tables of RecordTableRules.cs.

$fields.quickCreate: Expected IsQuickCreateEnabled. Always 'off': every listed table has quick create off on every environment (sprk_project was the one table on).
$fields.assign: Expected state of the three OOB Assign buttons (Mscrm.Form.<t>.Assign, Mscrm.HomepageGrid.<t>.Assign, Mscrm.SubGrid.<t>.Assign). Always 'hidden'. Hiding the command only: prvAssign is NOT removed from any role (owner Q12; UAC-r2 audit, task 063).
$fields.nativeNew: 'redirected' = the platform New is hidden on the grid and the form (New and Save & New) and a Spaarke 'New' opens the table's create surface; 'hidden-outright' = hidden everywhere, no replacement (the table has one server-side creator); 'kept' = the platform New stays (reason + owner question in the entry). -Verify gates the first two and reports the third.
$fields.launcher: The standalone launcher a redirected 'New' calls (JavaScriptFunction FunctionName @ Library).
$fields.gridButton: 'existing' = the grid already carries a Spaarke New wizard button (this merge only adds the missing hides); 'add' = this merge adds it.
